The image presents two line plots, titled "Easy Training Set" and "Hard Training Set," which compare the training rewards of different models over a range of steps. Both plots share the same x-axis and y-axis. The x-axis is labeled "Steps," has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 500, and has tick labels at intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" and has a linear scale, with a range from 0.0 to 0.4 for the "Easy Training Set" plot and from 0.0 to 0.2 for the "Hard Training Set" plot, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1 and 0.05, respectively. 

The "Easy Training Set" plot compares the training rewards of "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and "Llama-LUFFY-Easy." "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" is represented by a blue solid line, starting at approximately 0.1 and increasing to around 0.35 at 500 steps, with a steady upward trend. "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" is represented by a red solid line, starting at 0.0 and rising to approximately 0.37 at 500 steps, with some fluctuations.

The "Hard Training Set" plot compares the training rewards of "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" and "Llama-LUFFY-Hard." "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" is depicted by a blue solid line, beginning at 0.0, peaking at around 0.05 at 50 steps, and then declining to nearly 0.0 by 500 steps. "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" is represented by a red solid line, starting at 0.0, increasing to approximately 0.1 at 150 steps, and then fluctuating around 0.1 until 500 steps, with some minor variations.
